title: Chapter 877
paragraphs: Chapter 877
Episode 218. If you knock down one, a stronger one comes (6)
In the demon world, Sword Demon Castle.
Phaelito sighed as he looked at Sakiel, who had been summoned severely injured.

Sakiel Groshae, her name had always been regarded as a symbol of strategy and success in the demon world. She had raised the humble Groshae family to the 30th nobility in the demon world, and ultimately received a direct blessing from Zito and rose to the General Secretariat, an outstanding figure.
It was such Sakiel who had ruined the first major war, the most critical one, and even lost Zito's flesh.
"I am... ashamed."
"Sakiel, Lord Zito will soon come to Sword Demon Castle."
"I will accept any punishment."
"This is not the type of problem that can be solved by you being punished. Also, as your direct superior, I cannot escape responsibility."
Sakiel felt a heavy sense of guilt at Phaelito's words.
Phaelito wasn't saying he didn't want to get hurt because of Sakiel's mistake. He was saying he would take responsibility for her as her superior.
"So when Lord Zito comes, just keep quiet without any excuses."
"But Lord Phaelito."
"We don't have time, listen to me."
As soon as Phaelito replied, a purple magic circle was drawn in front of the two. Zito and a demon appeared together from within it.
Zito looked like his physical body was only half-formed compared to when he was fighting Ayula, and the demon standing next to him had green horns and wings unlike ordinary demons.
[Ah, these damn fools. Do I really have to personally intervene?]
Smack, snap-!
As soon as Zito emerged from the summoning circle, he slapped Phaelito's cheek hard and spat out a curse. The demon laughed heartily at this sight.
"That's why I asked you to send me, Lord Zito. If Phaelito had gone personally, it might have been different, but to entrust such an important task to a novice like Sakiel..."
"Ragal... What is this disrespectful speech in front of Lord Zito? Be quiet."
"Oh, I'm scared. Lord Zito says it's fine, but why are you fussing about it?"
Ragal was a demon who had been a general until recently, but had recently become a king.
"Receiving the title of king, now you seem unafraid of me."
Smack!
Zito punched Phaelito's jaw once more. Phaelito staggered but barely kept his stance.

"Are you no longer afraid of me? How, how could you guys do this to me? Don't you know I just got beaten up by Peace and am not in a good condition? I mean my precious flesh. Can you use it like that?]
"I will take all the responsibility, Lord Zito. If you use me as a substitute for your physical body, it will become more blood and flesh, so please forgive Sakiel."
"Do you do this knowing I hate such touching and uncomfortable pain? I almost gave in to Peace because of that. Ah, when will I overcome this..."]
"Lord Zito, if you allow, I will punish Sakiel."

"Don't trust me and nag too much at Phaelito, Ragal. You did well this time, but still, Phaelito is Phaelito. What will you do if he gets twisted and hits me from behind and you get in trouble, can you handle it?"
"I understand. But thanks to Lord Zito, I have also become much stronger."
"Oh my, cute. So cute that I just want to stomp on you and crush you, our Ragal. You are cute, so even if you talk back, I give you some slack. If Phaelito did that, he wouldn't have a chance."
"I'm sorry."
You did a good job.
That meant the transfer beyond the Huphester region. Ragal was in charge of invading the Lute Union, and he had won a considerable victory and returned.
"Well, I understand that you want to brag loudly at Phaelito now. You almost destroyed that Elona Zipple."
Phaelito's pupils widened at that.
Elona Zipple is currently one of the two peaks of clear humanity along with Chiron. He couldn't believe that someone like Ragal had achieved results against one of them.
"Hoo. Phaelito, and Sakiel."
"Yes, Lord Zito."
"What do I hate most in this world?"
"Love...."
"And it seems to be peace."
"No, no. Those two can be great ingredients for pain if used well. What I hate most in the world is a loss without pleasure."
Phaelito and Sakiel bowed their heads.

"If you guys used my precious flesh and something became more painful for humanity, or it became beautiful, there would be no problem. Rather, it should be a commendable thing. But what the hell is this time? You were fooled by the real Runcandel and Murakan and just consumed flesh without gaining anything."
"I'm sorry."

"You see, I've been getting weaker ever since I was released from the seal. I haven't found my eyes yet, and it's troublesome if my flesh is going out like this. Be careful in the future, got it? Ugh, I'm annoyed. Let's go back, Ragal."
At that statement, the pupils of Phaelito, Sakiel, and Ragal all widened simultaneously.
"…Lord Zito, are you not imposing any other punishment on me?"
"Didn't you get hit just now? Letting this slide is a one-time thing. I'm cutting you some slack because of what you guys have done up until now. We still have a lot of work ahead."
Ragal made a face, showing his disappointment.
"You seem discontented, Ragal."
"Not at all."
"What do people call you?"
"Pardon?"
"People refer to Phaelito as the 'Sword Demon'. What about you?"
"I am mostly known as the 'Poison King'. Otherwise, 'Ragal of Poison', 'Born from Poison', or 'Embodiment of Poison'…"
"All of those names except 'Poison King' sound crude. From today, you'll be the 'Poison Demon'. Ragal Fun, the Poison Demon. Sounds good. Considering you almost captured Elona, that title suits you."
"Uh… Thank you!"

The title 'Demon' had thus far been exclusive to Phaelito. The best spear-user in the demon realm was not called 'Spear Demon', nor was the best axe-user called 'Axe Demon'. It was an unwritten rule recognizing Phaelito's status as the best swordsman in the demon realm.

Sakiel realized there was a deeper meaning behind Zito's seemingly casual words. Through this ordeal, Phaelito and Sakiel were still able to rule over other demons at their usual rank. Ragal, who was internally discontented with Phaelito's sole leadership, also received a satisfactory reward.
"And Phaelito."
"Yes."

"It doesn't matter if Orgal is already dead. Once you can move freely on the surface, find Orgal and bring him to me. From now on, I will be focusing the dimensional rifts towards the sea and the Lutero Federation. You and Sakiel need to take responsibility and establish a few strongholds."
"We will do as you command."

"Good. I need to head back and have some fun. I also have some things to discuss with the witch about Orgal. Ah, I haven't even had the chance to properly explore the surface yet, why is everything so hectic?"
Soon after, Zito and Ragal departed from the Sword Demon Castle via a summoning circle.
"As soon as your injuries are healed, return to the surface, Sakiel. I will be tearing down the remaining Sealing Walls. Make sure there are no mistakes until then."
"Thank you, Lord Phaelito."

"By the time you arrive, the seven Demon Kings will already be summoned at the maritime base. Thus, forces from the Vamel Alliance or other human factions will find it difficult to attack the maritime base as they did this time."
"I will continue to attempt inland advancements through the Demon Kings. What about the Holy Kingdom?"
"I will personally search for Lord Zito's eyes. Until then, do not deploy any troops to attack the Holy Kingdom."
"Understood."
"And the red sword of the white knight who killed Flek Kaluga... I saw in the footage that fortunately, it's not yet complete."
"May I ask what you mean by 'not complete'?"
"It means there's a definite limit on the number of uses. It means that he will have to use it sparingly until he ascends to Genesis. We must deplete all of his power before he meets Zito."
"How do we do that?"

"We will continue to bring the kings to the surface, creating a situation where White Whale has to deal with them alone. The death and disappearance of the kings will not be a problem as long as we deplete all of his power. Without his red power, he will pose no threat."
Or, beyond that, he might even pose a threat to Inse.
Phaelito finished with a smile.
Lutero Magic Federation, Tower of Story.
Veradin looked up at Elona with a worried face. Elona was floating with her eyes closed, the tower's power was healing her. Little by little, Vahn Ragal's poison was leaving her body.
"Ragal Phun, he was the one who did this to Lady Elona."
"Yes, Lord. They say he's one of the kings of the demon world."
It was no different that Ragal was able to corner Elona.

He was of the same breed as Drek Hon, whom the Vamel Federation had faced in the past. Ragal's poison ability was specialized for mass slaughter, and Elona couldn't fight properly because she was protecting the citizens of the federation from it.

As a result, Elona had to deal with all the poison that could instantly kill tens of millions of ordinary people. Still, nearly a hundred thousand citizens of the Lutero Federation met their death, but without her, at least a hundred times that number would have died.

At the same time, other superhumans of Zipple were cleaning up cracks in other areas, and Zipple currently can't perform long-distance communication and space leaps like the Vamel Federation. Therefore, even if a superhuman cleared the battlefield, it was difficult to go support Elona.
The citizens should have died. If so, Ragal wouldn't have returned alive, and Elona wouldn't have been hurt so much. In a pure head-on confrontation, Ragal could never be a match for Elona.
Ultimately, it would have resulted in fewer deaths.
Veradin thought so, but he didn't say it out loud because it would upset Elona if she heard it.
"Betty, Almatia, Coon."
The three bio-golems with names.
They currently had command authority similar to other brains of Zipple. Among them, especially about the Devil's Stone, they held the third authority after Veradin and Elona.
"Yes, Lord."
"Speak, Lord."
"Inscribe the name of Ragal Phun, that devil, into the Devil's Stone. When the Devil's Stone can use a proper level of power, the first thing to do is to end his life."
